query.text: 请帮我观察接线，告诉我画面中不同颜色的线正接向哪个位置。

annotation.text_zh: 蓝线的一端接在画面左侧的白色端子上。
annotation.text_en: One end of the blue wire is connected to the white terminal on the left of the image.

annotation.text_zh: 你正在把红线插向画面中间的白色端子。
annotation.text_en: You are trying to insert the red wire into the white terminal in the middle of the image.

annotation.text_zh: 你拿起了蓝线的另一端，正将它移向中间的白色端子。
annotation.text_en: You have picked up the other end of the blue wire and are moving it toward the white terminal in the middle.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
